journeys.requirement: Wallet/Exchange reviewed swap reaches required finality and reconciles with canonical Indexer state.
Adverse price movement/minimum-output path fails closed or settles only within reviewed slippage bound.
Stale quote/oracle freshness is rejected before unsafe submission; live canonical TWAP/reference health is independently observed.
Wallet/Exchange refuses reviewed execution when provider chain identity differs from the official testnet manifest.
Inactive canonical market cannot be executed through the canonical Swap path.
Reviewed/submitted execution cannot be replayed or reused outside its nonce/session/authorization constraints.
Reorg/replacement is detected, not misreported as final, and recovery/reconciliation preserves canonical history.
PaymentRouter -> CanonicalSettlementAdapter -> CanonicalSwapExecutor settles through the exact deployed trusted-caller graph.

evidence_policy: Synthetic fixtures/unit tests validate the harness only and never satisfy a live journey.
Every live journey must bind to the exact deployed release-candidate SHA, official chain ID, transaction/block evidence where applicable, and sanitized immutable evidence.

Missing official testnet manifest, placeholder endpoints, missing deployed code, unresolved Registry bindings, missing live workflow evidence, reorg/conflict, or stale/oracle failure must fail closed.
Private keys, seed phrases, RPC credentials, auth headers and raw sensitive proof payloads must never be committed.
blocker: Repository launch authority states the public testnet is not yet authorized/live; official testnet manifest is absent and public endpoints remain placeholders.
